limitations: Synchronous strict open-neighborhood majority with tie retention only. No claim for asynchronous updates, other threshold rules, or nonmatching edge deletions. Some historical full texts were inaccessible.
scientific_integrity: The statement is proved for all m>=4 and r>=0; finite checks are supplementary. Priority rests on a bounded best-knowledge literature and indexed-result comparison, not a global uniqueness guarantee.
title: Majority orbit transitions after deleting a matching from a complete graph
